title: Don't Worry
description: Part of the Feels Like a Movie series, Don't Worry captures a quiet, deeply intimate moment between two women - the gentle, everyday act of one girl braiding another’s hair. The painting adopts the distinct aesthetic of flash photography, channeling the raw, candid intimacy of a nocturnal snapshot or an unscripted movie still. The harsh, direct light isolates the hands and figures against a dark background, freezing a fleeting gesture of care, tenderness, and mutual trust. Translating tactile touch into visual language, the composition continues the exploration of contemporary intimacy, female closeness, and emotional safety. It is a cinematic fragment where a simple physical gesture becomes a quiet promise of reassurance: don't worry.
